description: Source code for VP9 video rate control wrapper, including functions for calculating keyframe size percentage, and template specializations for VP9 rate control configuration and frame parameter conversions.

classes.name: VP9RateControl
classes.description: Template class specialized for VP9 rate control, providing methods for getting loop filter level, post-encode updates, and converting control configs and frame parameters.

methods.name: GetLoopfilterLevel
methods.description: Returns the loop filter level for VP9 rate control.

methods.name: PostEncodeUpdate
methods.description: Updates rate control state after encoding a frame.

methods.name: ConvertControlConfig
methods.description: Converts generic rate control configuration to VP9-specific configuration.

methods.name: ConvertFrameParams
methods.description: Converts generic frame parameters to VP9-specific frame parameters.
